body:
Hi.
I create now adv app, but I get this error.
When I try run command:

```
./yii fixture User
```

 I get 

```
Error: The dir argument must be a directory.
```

but 

```
./yii fixture/generate-all
```

work good.
It can not find directory: `/path_to_root_dir/tests/unit/fixtures`

what will be problem in?

@DenisOgr can you please create separated issue ? Thanks 
The probem could be in wrong alias defined in `yii2-advanced` that will be using to get FixturePath by [namespace](https://github.com/yiisoft/yii2/blob/master/framework/console/controllers/FixtureController.php#L56) Will check it

@samdark can you change `namespace` attribute of `FixtureController` to [this](https://github.com/yiisoft/yii2/blob/master/apps/advanced/tests/codeception/common/fixtures/UserFixture.php#L3) similar like it is done for other [things](https://github.com/yiisoft/yii2/blob/master/apps/advanced/tests/codeception/bin/yii#L23) , or i will submit PR later , thanks
@Ragazzo Do you need to create separate task?

i mean change its attribute `namespace` in `yii2 - advanced` [config](https://github.com/yiisoft/yii2/blob/master/apps/advanced/tests/codeception/bin/yii#L23) to `tests\codeception\common\fixtures` this should solve the problem , since for loading fixtures they are found by [generating file path from fixture namespace](https://github.com/yiisoft/yii2/blob/master/framework/console/controllers/FixtureController.php#L465)
Would you submit a pull request? I don't really understand how to reproduce the problem on my end.
Ok , but only next week , if it is ok
